3532-5078-6607-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4131-5315-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4131-5315-5660-6769.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

574-1445-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
574-1445-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
574-1445-4871-5631.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-3899-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-3899-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1170-1976-5131-5226--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-5131-5226--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

877-3184-4645-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-6264-7767.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to discard a card.
803-6264-7767.description:
Discard a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters as a Villain due to Arcane Adaptation, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Repeat from step 2.
803-6264-7767.notes: You will need to break the combo, or you will eventually lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3490-4050-6752-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6752-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-4321-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

643-3490-5231-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
643-3490-5231-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Maskwood Nexus, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4871-6705.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1409-1510-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Stinger by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Stinger leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Stinger
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Stinger when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Stinger and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2012-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
997-2012-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3490-4050-6283-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-6283-7399.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Bogwater Lumaret indestructible.
3490-4050-6283-7399.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2557-4871-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
2557-4871-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
2557-4871-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

4559-5272-5315-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5272-5315-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-7179.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-7179.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Disruptor of Currents and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Disruptor of Currents enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Disruptor of Currents and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-7179.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

1409-2097-5421.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2854-4211-4574-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-4211-4574-5741.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-4264.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Altered Ego.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altered Ego by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

856-2173-5147-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-5147-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-5147-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4050-4192-4394-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1066-2634-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
1066-2634-5259.description:
Cast Borne Upon a Wind by paying {1}{U}, allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

372-1938-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Icewind Stalwart exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Glorious Protector.
372-1938-4200.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Abdel Adrian to return to the battlefield from exile and triggering Abdel Adrian and Glorious Protector.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

645-1267-2511-3908.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2511-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

351-4067.notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Dagger attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
351-4067.description:
Activate the creature with Quicksilver Dagger attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the creature with Quicksilver Dagger attached.
Repeat.

1636-4102-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Psionic Gift attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4102-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, targeting any target.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

328-387-1283-2034-2693.notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant in hand.You control less than two Thrulls.
328-387-1283-2034-2693.description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {5}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {2} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-2034-4404-4751.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk, adding {C}{C}.
Verdurous Gearhulk dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Corridor Monitor, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Repeat.

2269-3433-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {G}.
Hornet Queen dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Hornet Queen on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Hornet Queen from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Insect tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2076-3705-4050.description:
Cast Squee, the Immortal by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve Birgi's trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve Hazoret's Monument's trigger, allowing you to discard a card to draw a card.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Repeat.

618-2857-3385.description:
Cast Kiki-Jiki, letting him resolve.
Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to Kiki-Jiki.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Adarkar Valkyrie with haste.
Tap the Adarkar Valkyrie token targeting Kiki-Jiki.
Allow the triggers to resolve.
Kiki-Jiki dies to the 2 damage and is returned to the battlefield by Adarkar Valkyrie.
Repeat.

228-4277-4385.notablePrerequisites: At least 2 cards in hand or
228-4277-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen creating a 1/1 token.
Equip Skullclamp to the token.
The token dies drawing you 2 cards.
Exile both cards from your hand to gain {4}.
Repeat.

193-1621-4344.description:
Activate Animatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield.
Wispweaver Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.
